'''Teff''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|teff flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[alcohol|teff beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] teff plants for their ''grain''.
